effects.anyone: Anyone in the organization can respond — the board or any agent, including the one that asked.
effects.notCreator: Anyone in the organization except the agent that created the card, and its run. Use this when the answer has to come from someone else.
effects.humanOnly: Only a person on the board can respond. Agents are turned away.

summary.humanOnlyAssigned: Assigned to {{addressee}}. Only a person on the board can respond — agents cannot resolve this card.
summary.humanOnly: Only a person on the board can respond — agents cannot resolve this card.
summary.addresseeOrBoard: Only {{addressee}} or a person on the board can respond.
summary.notCreator: Anyone in the organization except {{creator}} can respond.
summary.anyone: Anyone in the organization can respond — the board or any agent, including the one that asked.

shortSummary.addresseeOrBoard: Only {{addressee}} or the board can respond

narrowed.governedAction: This card runs a governed action, so it stays human-only whatever audience was requested.
narrowed.companyCap: Organization interaction governance narrowed this from {{from}} to {{to}}.
narrowed.legacy: Created before Anyone became the default, so it stays restricted. A new card would be open.
